Migration.Name: Add_Location_Full_Address_Reference
Migration.Comments: Add the view RV_Location with the full address of a location (DisplayName), the Location reference displayed by it and the Location identifiers

Step.SQLStatement: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW RV_Location AS -- Address (C_Location) with its full address to display (Address 1, Address 2, Postal City, Region; empty parts left out), -- the city and region resolved from C_City / C_Region and the columns to filter. SQL-99: PostgreSQL and Oracle. SELECT l.C_Location_ID, l.AD_Client_ID, l.AD_Org_ID, l.IsActive, l.Created, l.CreatedBy, l.Updated, l.UpdatedBy, l.Address1, l.Address2, l.Postal, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(l.City),''),ci.Name) AS City, l.C_City_ID, l.C_Region_ID, COALESCE(r.Name,NULLIF(TRIM(l.RegionName),'')) AS RegionName, l.C_Country_ID, co.Name AS CountryName, l.Latitude, l.Longitude, TRIM(TRIM(LEADING ',' FROM CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(l.Address1),'') IS NULL THEN '' ELSE ', '||NULLIF(TRIM(l.Address1),'') END ||CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(l.Address2),'') IS NULL THEN '' ELSE ', '||NULLIF(TRIM(l.Address2),'') END ||CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(TRIM(l.Postal),'')||' '||COALESCE(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(l.City),''),ci.Name),'')),'') IS NULL THEN '' ELSE ', '||NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(TRIM(l.Postal),'')||' '||COALESCE(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(l.City),''),ci.Name),'')),'') END ||CASE WHEN COALESCE(r.Name,NULLIF(TRIM(l.RegionName),'')) IS NULL THEN '' ELSE ', '||COALESCE(r.Name,NULLIF(TRIM(l.RegionName),'')) END)) AS DisplayName FROM C_Location l LEFT JOIN C_City ci ON (ci.C_City_ID=l.C_City_ID) LEFT JOIN C_Region r ON (r.C_Region_ID=l.C_Region_ID) LEFT JOIN C_Country co ON (co.C_Country_ID=l.C_Country_ID)
